actions.value:
. /home/probe/session-env; date -u +%FT%T.%N; pid=$(pgrep -n -x localsend_app || pgrep -n -x localsend); echo PID=$pid; cat /proc/$pid/stat; getconf CLK_TCK; flatpak info org.localsend.localsend_app; gsettings get org.gnome.desktop.a11y.applications screen-magnifier-enabled; gsettings get org.gnome.desktop.interface toolkit-accessibility; . /home/probe/session-env
date -u +%FT%T.%N
pid=$(pgrep -n -x localsend)
echo PID=$pid
cat /proc/$pid/stat
addr=$(gdbus call --session --dest org.a11y.Bus --object-path /org/a11y/bus --method org.a11y.Bus.GetAddress | cut -d "'" -f2)
echo A11Y_BUS=$addr
busctl --address="$addr" --no-pager list
nohup timeout 115 dbus-monitor --address "$addr" "interface='org.a11y.atspi.Component'" > /home/probe/evidence/round10-dbus-monitor.log 2>&1 < /dev/null &
sudo -n nohup timeout 115 strace -tt -T -f -yy -e trace=poll,ppoll,sendmsg,recvmsg,sendto,recvfrom -s8192 -o /home/probe/evidence/round10-selfcall.log -p "$pid" > /home/probe/evidence/round10-strace-attach.log 2>&1 < /dev/null &
date -u +%FT%T.%N

. /home/probe/session-env; date -u +%FT%T.%N; cat /home/probe/evidence/round10-strace-attach.log; cat /home/probe/evidence/round10-dbus-monitor.log; grep -E "25000|24999|GetExtents|NoReply|timed out|Timeout" /home/probe/evidence/round10-selfcall.log; pid=$(pgrep -n -x localsend); echo PID=$pid; cat /proc/$pid/stat; timeout 10 gnome-screenshot -f /home/probe/evidence/round10-native.png; echo SCREENSHOT_BASE64; base64 -w0 /home/probe/evidence/round10-native.png; echo
